title: Golden T-Shirt: manifest integrity and reference resolution
description: Checks the integrity of the Golden T-Shirt v1 manifest (every listed file exists with a matching digest, no unlisted file in the fixture directory, correct fixtureDigest; D2P-REF-011, D2P-REF-012) and resolves the expanded bundle of all input and expected files plus the external files. A fixture whose digests do not match is rejected, so no comparison against it can start (QEV-001).
